current_episode.title: Nickie West - Unpacks FIT Show 2025: Innovation, Growth and What’s Next

guest.bio_context: Nikki West is the Event Director of The Fit Show, a role that spreads across several shows but with her primary passion and attention focused on the Fit Show. She has been instrumental in growing the event to its eighth edition, overseeing the largest and most successful show to date with record attendance and international representation.

context.real_quote: If you're selling in the home improvement sector, you have to be here. And if you're buying, if you've got to source products or you want to buy anything, you've got to be at Fit Show.
key_stats: 50% of exhibitors are brand new to Fit Show and have never exhibited before
50 members of the Timber Joinery Network represented at Fit Show 2025 for the first time
Seven systems houses at Fit Show 2025, up from two systems houses in 2023
International presence from over 20 countries at Fit Show 2025, a first for the event

pending_qa.q: How has the product range at Fit Show evolved beyond its PVC origins?
pending_qa.r: Fit Show started its journey as a predominantly PVC show, but now features aluminium, PVC, glass, and timber with great focus. The event includes 50 members of the Timber Joinery Network represented for the first time, which appeals to builders and property developers around the sustainability of using timber in construction. Products now span windows and doors, roof lanterns, garage doors, decking, fencing, guttering, and roofing.

pending_qa.q: What is the strategic importance of in-person trade shows despite the availability of digital product information?
pending_qa.r: There is nothing like being in person and touching, feeling products, and talking to people directly. Many visitors come to put names to faces they talk to every day. Looking at people in the whites of their eyes, especially in a tougher economic climate, is important to show the world that you are fit for business.

pending_qa.q: How many systems houses exhibited at Fit Show 2025 compared to previous editions?
pending_qa.r: In 2023, Fit Show had two systems houses. Visitors provided feedback that they wanted more systems houses, as it was important to them. This year, 2025, the show has seven systems houses, which represents an amazing increase.

pending_qa.q: What international scope has Fit Show achieved for the first time?
pending_qa.r: Fit Show now has a real international presence from over 20 countries here, which is a first for Fit Show. This international representation has become increasingly useful for attendance and is making the show more of an international event.

pending_qa.q: When is Fit Show scheduled for 2027 and what is the preparation timeline?
pending_qa.r: Fit Show 2027 is scheduled for the 18th to the 20th of May 2027. Although this seems a long way away, it takes every ounce of energy to start the journey now. The campaign for 2027 has already been launched, with conversations beginning with exhibitors about securing prime spots on the floor plan.

pending_qa.q: What is the scope of machinery representation at Fit Show 2025?
pending_qa.r: Fit Show 2025 has the biggest representative representation of machinery that has ever been displayed before, which is massively important for the fabricators and demonstrates that the show really does deliver to every single link in the supply chain for the fenestration sector.
